notes: Owner-approved StoneVeld business information. Informational answers only, no promises of availability.

facts.title: About StoneVeld Studios
facts.answer: Welcome to StoneVeld Studios. The studio works on website design and development, creative design and visual storytelling, and practical technology solutions. You can also explore its projects and developer tools.

facts.title: Website design and development
questions: Can you build me a website?
Can you improve an existing website?
I need a website for my business
facts.answer: Looking to build your first website or improve an existing one? StoneVeld Studios offers website design and development. Share what you have in mind with the team to discuss the scope.

facts.title: Creative design and visual storytelling
questions: Can you help with visual storytelling?
facts.answer: StoneVeld Studios explores creative concepts, visual design and storytelling. Tell the team about your idea to discuss the project scope and available services.

facts.title: Technical solutions
questions: Can you help with computer problems?
Can someone help with Linux or software?
facts.answer: StoneVeld Studios offers practical help with software, systems and everyday technology problems. Describe the issue to the team so you can discuss suitable assistance.

facts.title: How projects begin
questions: How do we start a project?
What happens after I contact StoneVeld?
facts.answer: Start by sharing your idea or problem with the team. The next steps are to review the requirements, agree on a direction and scope, then build, review and test the result.
facts.linkLabel: See how to start a project

facts.title: Contact StoneVeld Studios
questions: How can I contact the team?
I want to speak to someone
How do I send an enquiry?
facts.answer: You can reach the team at info@stoneveldstudios.co.za. The email link opens your email application so you can write your enquiry. I cannot send messages for you.

facts.title: Quotes and pricing
questions: How much does a website cost?
Is the initial project discussion free?
Do you charge for a quote?
facts.answer: Initial project discussions and quotations are free. I don’t have confirmed prices to share for project work; costs depend on the requirements and agreed scope. Tell the team what you have in mind to discuss a quotation.
facts.source: No approved fixed price list; owner policy. Free initial project discussions and quotations owner-approved 2026-11-06.
facts.linkLabel: See how to discuss your project

facts.title: Operating hours and availability
questions: Can I email you outside business hours?
facts.answer: StoneVeld Studios' enquiry hours (South African Standard Time, UTC+2) are Monday–Friday 08:00–17:00 and Saturday 09:00–13:00. Sunday is closed. You can send an email outside these hours, but replies depend on team availability. Enquiry hours do not guarantee immediate assistance, confirmed appointments or emergency support.
facts.source: Owner-approved StoneVeld Studios enquiry hours, 2026-11-06; same hours listed on StoneVeld Studios Facebook Page. No live availability feed.

facts.title: The StoneVeld team
questions: Who are Crow Bianca and Hannes?
facts.answer: StoneVeld Studios works across technical development, visual design and creative direction. Crow, Bianca and Hannes contribute their different skills to the studio.
facts.source: Owner-approved team description and public studio pages

facts.title: Crow's Studio
facts.answer: Crow focuses on technical development, integration, software and practical problem-solving at StoneVeld Studios. The public site has a dedicated Crow's Studio page.
facts.source: Owner-approved role and public studio page

facts.title: Bia's Studio
facts.answer: Bianca contributes visual identity, design and content presentation. Her public studio page is Bia's Studio.
facts.source: Owner-approved role and public studio page

facts.title: Wolfbyte Studio
facts.answer: Hannes contributes creative direction, visual concepts and storytelling. The public StoneVeld website includes Wolfbyte Studio.
facts.source: Owner-approved role and public studio page

facts.title: Contact an individual team member
questions: How can I email Hannes directly?
facts.answer: You can use the team’s public business email addresses to reach a named person. For general enquiries, email info@stoneveldstudios.co.za.
facts.linkLabel: Email the team about a person or project

facts.title: Contingency Federation
facts.answer: Contingency Federation is a StoneVeld project exploring a collaborative workspace for teams, software development and shared work. Visit its project page for the published details.

facts.title: Open tools and experiments
questions: Do you have open source tools?
Where can I find developer tools?
facts.answer: StoneVeld Studios has an Open Tools and Experiments section for developer tools and technical projects.

facts.title: StoneVeld Nexus
facts.answer: StoneVeld Nexus is the studio's digital product and release area. Check its current page for available items; the assistant cannot confirm a paid checkout service.

facts.title: About this digital assistant
questions: What can you help me with?
facts.answer: Hello, I’m StoneVeld Assistant, your digital guide to the studio. I can help you explore services, projects and contact details. I’m not a human team member and can’t make commitments for the team.

facts.title: StoneVeld Studios on Facebook
questions: Do you have a Facebook page?
Where can I follow StoneVeld on Facebook?
Where can I see your social media?
facts.answer: Yes — StoneVeld Studios has an official Facebook Page. Follow the studio there for posts and updates. For project enquiries, you can also contact the team by email.
facts.source: Official StoneVeld Studios Facebook Page, confirmed by the page's public canonical address on 2026-11-06.
